name: replynodes-hackernews
description: Read-only Hacker News public reads through the ReplyNodes Hacker News public-read service: front-page and category feeds, single-item fetch with bounded comment threading, user profiles, and term search. Two truthful access paths are supported: Bearer workspace-key and x402 v2 negotiation at the gateway. No submit, vote, comment, favorite, login, account, or other write/authenticated capability exists; no availability, uptime, latency, success-rate, or payment-settlement claim is made.

auth.description: ReplyNodes workspace API key. Prepaid credits are debited synchronously before the upstream read runs; failed requests are never charged. The same key unlocks x402 v2 alternative negotiation; omit Authorization and follow the returned 402 to attempt x402 v2 settlement with a separately configured payer.

tools.name: hackernews_get_stories_top
tools.description: List front-page Hacker News stories (bounded page).

tools.name: hackernews_get_stories_new
tools.description: List newest Hacker News stories (bounded page).

tools.name: hackernews_get_stories_best
tools.description: List best Hacker News stories (bounded page).

tools.name: hackernews_get_stories_job
tools.description: List Hacker News jobs postings (bounded page).

tools.name: hackernews_get_item
tools.description: Fetch one Hacker News item with bounded comment thread.

depth.description: Max comment depth to inline; deeper comments are dropped and reported in meta.missing_fields.

tools.name: hackernews_get_user
tools.description: Fetch one public Hacker News user profile.

tools.name: hackernews_search
tools.description: Search Hacker News by free-text term with optional tag filters (bounded page).

q.description: Free-text search query; required and never empty after trimming.

tags.description: Comma-separated tag filters (story, comment, poll, show_hn, ask_hn, front_page).
